page_title: LYO 1-0 MAR | Lyon v Marseille 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Benoit Bastien is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+5' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+4' Total attempts – 12:8.
90+3' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) takes the corner with a short pass.
90+3' Malick Fofana (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.
90+2' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is able to continue to play.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
89' It's a free kick to Marseille, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
89' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes.
86' Substitution. Adryelson (Lyon) on for Alexandre Lacazette.
86' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

85' Amine Harit (Marseille) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nemanja Matic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Paul Akouokou (Lyon).
81' Here is a change. Quentin Merlin is going off and Gennaro Gattuso gives the last tactical orders to Ulisses Garcia (Marseille).
80' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
78' 40:60 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

76' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
75' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
75' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
72' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Pau Lopez to dive and make a save.
70' Today's match ends for Gift Orban who will be replaced by Malick Fofana (Lyon).
69' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
67' Clinton Mata (Lyon) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
66' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Amine Harit (Marseille) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
61' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Nemanja Matic (Lyon) for a tough tackle.
59' Substitution. Abdoul Bamo Meite walks off the pitch and Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
59' Gennaro Gattuso prepares a substitution. Iliman Ndiaye is replaced by Faris Moumbagna (Marseille).
58' One of the players from Marseille times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
55' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.

54' Clinton Mata (Lyon) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Pau Lopez who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
52' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Lyon take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Lyon have a corner.
50' Marseille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' Pierre Sage has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) comes on the pitch for Nicolas Tagliafico.
46' The whistle blows and Benoit Bastien starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Luis Henrique (Marseille) heads on.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Bastien interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
43' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Pau Lopez. What a save!
43' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) squanders a great opportunity after striking the ball onto the post!
40' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.
36' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
36' A pass into the penalty area from Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is intercepted by the defence.
34' Good play from Jean Onana (Marseille) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Marseille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' A player from Lyon pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Marseille have a free kick.
23' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Marseille are ruled offside.
21' The foul by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) was seen by Benoit Bastien who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
18' Clinton Mata (Lyon) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Anthony Lopes comfortably gathers the ball.
15' Amine Harit (Marseille) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
14' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Gift Orban collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
13' A snap shot by Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
12' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
11' Gift Orban (Lyon) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the left post.
8' The ball is cleared after Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

5' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
4' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

1' That was absolutely fantastic! Amine Harit (Marseille) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
